KHL Player Profile

Source: R/khl.R
khl_player_profile.Rd

Player profile: bio, contract, club (one row).

Usage

khl_player_profile(player_id, headers = NULL, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

player_id

Required. khl.ru player id (the box score / roster player_id).

headers

Named list of extra request headers, merged over the defaults (X-Requested-With, Origin, Referer). The cookie jar and sessid are kept in-process, so nothing needs reusing across calls.

return_parsed

Logical. TRUE (default) returns the parsed fastRhockey_data tibble; FALSE returns the raw khl.ru envelope as a list (status, data, errors; betting fields removed).

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (31 columns; zero rows with the same columns when the payload is empty), or the raw body as a list when return_parsed = FALSE. Raises fastRhockey_no_data (nothing there, or an unknown season / stage), fastRhockey_asset_fetch (an error envelope, an answer for another id than the one asked, or a failed fetch) and fastRhockey_bad_request (an invalid argument or an HTTP 400 / 422).

col_nametypesdescription
player_idintegerkhl.ru player id; equals webcaster player khl_id
firstnamecharacterFirst name in Russian
lastnamecharacterLast name in Russian
photocharacterPlayer photo URL on khl.ru (protocol-relative)
positioncharacterPosition code (Russian letter on www.khl.ru)
position_codecharacterPosition key in English (goaltender, defender, forward)
biographycharacterBiography text in Russian (HTML)
is_herologicalSite 'hero' flag (unverified meaning)
is_riplogicalTrue for a deceased player
links_statscharacterRelative khl.ru page path
pagelinkcharacterRelative khl.ru page path
summary_stats_gpintegerCareer KHL games played (profile summary)
summary_stats_aintegerCareer KHL assists (profile summary)
summary_stats_pmintegerCareer KHL plus-minus (profile summary)
summary_stats_gintegerCareer KHL goals (profile summary)
summary_stats_ptsintegerCareer KHL points (profile summary)
jnintegerJersey number (not an id; 0 on a team event)
club_namecharacterName in Russian (Cyrillic); the *_en / *en sibling holds the English transliteration
club_logocharacterCurrent club logo URL on khl.ru (protocol-relative)
club_codecharacterClub slug (/clubs//)
heightcharacterHeight with its Russian unit ('183 sm' = 183 cm)
weightcharacterWeight with its Russian unit ('85 kg' = 85 kg)
birthdatecharacterBirth date (Russian display format)
agecharacterAge with its Russian unit ('27 let' = 27 years)
contract_namecharacterContract label in Russian
contract_datecharacterContract end date
country_namecharacterName in Russian (Cyrillic); the *_en / *en sibling holds the English transliteration
country_flagcharacterFlag image path of the player's country (citizenship)
sport_country_namecharacterName in Russian (Cyrillic); the *_en / *en sibling holds the English transliteration
sport_country_flagcharacterFlag image path of the country the player represents in sport
stickcharacterShooting hand: l = left, r = right

Details

Endpoint: POST https://www.khl.ru/rest/players/profile/.

khl.ru REST needs a primed session (a GET of the site root sets the cookie jar and the Bitrix sessid, then each call POSTs a form); this is done for you, one session per host per R session, re-primed when the site rotates its cookie or the sessid expires. No route takes a year: season (the END year, 2026 = 2025/26) and stage are mapped to the tournament id (tnId) through the webcaster season table, or pass tournament_id (the All-Star games have their own tnId).

Ids and counts are integers (sdv-py Int64); a column holding values past 2^31 (epoch milliseconds) is returned as a whole-number double.

At least one second is left between two requests to a host.

Owner flag (sanctions). The KHL and its webcaster platform are run by Russian operators, some clubs by sanctioned state companies. Fetching on your own machine is fine; any published data release, hosted mirror or redistribution needs owner (sanctions / legal) sign-off first.
